title: Patch: the AI prices Burn and Toxic counters on units and heroes
thread:
**Issue #3822 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3822: Patch: the AI prices Burn and Toxic counters on units and heroes
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The newest set added Burn and Toxic: counters that hurt a unit or a hero at the start of its turn, Burn fading by 3 a tick and Toxic forever. The practice AI counts none of it. To the AI, a hero carrying Toxic 3 is as healthy as one without, and a unit about to burn to death is worth its full stats. Once this is built, the AI sees that damage coming: it doesn't spend an attack on a unit that will die by itself, it races harder when its own hero is on a Toxic clock, and it values putting Burn on the opponent's board.

## Why

- `crates/engine/src/afflictions.rs:47-62` exposes `burn_on`, `toxic_on`, `hero_burn_of` and `hero_toxic_of`, and nothing in `crates/ai/src` calls them. Grepping `burn|toxic` there finds only the feature layout's list of uncounted keywords (`features.rs:77-87`).
- The hand eval already prices Plague counters (`evaluate.rs:479-480`, `w.plague_counter`). The hero term is `hero_value(effective_life(..))` plus armor (`evaluate.rs:778-781`), with no affliction.
- SPEC §6, the Burn and Toxic rows, and R3540001: Burn ticks 8, 5, 2 and is gone; Toxic never drops and pierces Armor. Both are public (R3540005), so pricing them reads nothing hidden.
- The learned correction only re-scores finalists, and its layout leaves both out until a refit (`features.rs:77`). The beam prunes on the hand eval (`crates/ai/README.md`, "The learned evaluation"), and the reply sim sees at most one tick a side.
- About 29 card scripts deal Burn or Toxic (grep). Players already bring them against the AI (R3535000), and fullsend 2 (#3574) measures the AI on the set with a sweep whose bans are capped, so an AI blind to the set's damage over time costs bans there.

## Proposal

Add named weights to `EvalWeights`: set in `AI_EVAL`, and 0 in `GREEDY_EVAL` as the newer terms are, so the greedy baseline is unchanged.

- A unit's worth falls by its coming ticks, met by Divine Shield and Armor as R3540001 says. A unit the next tick kills is worth only what it can still do before then.
- A hero's side loses its coming ticks over a named horizon: Toxic every turn of it, and Burn's decaying series.

Every number goes in `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (CLAUDE.md rule 9). The AI README's evaluation section names the new terms.

## Where it lands

`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs` and `decide.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`; SPEC §6 (Burn, Toxic) and §9.9 are read, not changed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Evaluate tests: Burn or Toxic on an enemy unit raises the seat's eval and on its own unit lowers it; a unit its next tick kills is worth less than the same unit without the counter; a hero's Toxic weighs more than an equal Burn over the horizon.
- [ ] A decide test: one attacker, two equal enemy targets, one of which its own Burn kills next turn; the AI attacks the other.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL`'s new weights are 0, and the greedy baseline's tests are unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` at smoke size is green.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 150 lines plus tests, all in `crates/ai` (hard by rule 11). The risk is a weight that costs strength elsewhere, so the gate is the check; the horizon is a tuning number to revisit after #3574's sweep.
```
